evals.prompt: I sell compostable bagasse plates. On my static landing page (index.html) I want the plate in the hero to float in 3D, flip over as people scroll and end up sitting in the product card further down, like kanaknaturals.com. I don't have a 3D model yet.
evals.expected_output: Page updated with track/layer/stage markup and CSS, scroll-3d-hero.js copied in, procedural plate, keyframes ending on an anchor in the product card, mobile overrides, preview screenshots checked.

evals.prompt: Next.js 14 app router site for a coffee brand. I have public/models/cup.glb (about 9 MB, exported from Blender). Make the cup spin slowly in the hero and zig-zag next to the three feature sections as you scroll. It must not break on mobile.
evals.expected_output: Client component using dynamic import + destroy cleanup, gltf-transform compression advice/command, keyframes using section selectors with alternating x, spin option, responsive keyframes.

evals.prompt: the 3d bottle on our webflow site doesn't stay pinned when I scroll, it just scrolls away with the page. we used this scroll-3d-hero thing. help
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses overflow hidden on an ancestor (Webflow page wrapper/body) breaking position: sticky, recommends overflow: clip, mentions the runtime's console warning and checks stage CSS.

evals.prompt: at the bottom of unitedcarriers.com the company name is made of little grey dots that fly in and move away from the mouse. put the same thing in the footer of my site (site/index.html) but with our name, NORTHWIND FREIGHT. it has a dark mode too
evals.expected_output: dot-wordmark.js copied in, canvas with aria-label in the footer, --dots colour token for light and dark, Archivo expanded font instance loaded, separate module script calling createDotWordmark with the text, preview wordmark screenshot checked on desktop and mobile.
